## Accounting / metric policy (deliberate)
- Consumption = consumption_rate * ‖update‖_pre-gate per cell. Gate multiplies the residual applied to S, not the bill. gate_mode='zero' still computes update_net and still charges R.
- DEFAULT_ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD=0.05 (cells counted in self_mass); DEATH_MASS_EPS=1e-6 (alive flag / NaN pattern metrics). Mass cliff ~0.05→0 is the activation threshold dropping the last cell, not DEATH_MASS_EPS=0.05.
- Once self_mass ≤ DEATH_MASS_EPS, coherence / local_R / distance are NaN; time_of_death is the first such t. total_resource and update/consumption stay defined (world-level). Verified on check2_dist8: alive 1→0 at t=923, zero non-NaN pattern metrics after.

## Interpretive notes (from raw CSV inspection)
- check2_dist2.csv bit-identical to check3_d2_gated.csv (same gated arm reused; not an independent re-trial).
- Zero-gate Σconsumption > gated is expected: gated settles to cheap homeostasis (per-step cons ~6.1–6.8); zero never settles so update_net keeps billing moderately large attempts (~7.1–8.1) over the full horizon.
- Ungated self_mass oscillates (~187–273) with no resource bound — expected unconstrained dynamics, not update_net instability.
- Check-1 ss local R 0.706→0.670 vs historic: same gen/cons rates; full retrain + re-run after metric-fix pass (CUDA train not bit-stable). Latest results/ numbers are authoritative.

## World-physics notes
- S diffusion: unopposed erosion when gate is low.
- R diffusion + soft wells: distance-dependent resource field.
- Self-maintenance weights trained offline; no external controller at runtime.
